tagline: A course website from a few data files.
lede: Describe your course in a few JSON files and write your slides in Markdown. Course kit builds the home page, schedule, slide decks, practice worksheets and instructor lesson plans, with light and dark themes and a syllabus that prints clean.

usage.caption: eleventy.config.js: the whole setup. Then fill in _data/ and write your pages.

features.title: A syllabus and schedule from data
features.description: Put the course, the calendar, grading and policies in small JSON files. The kit works out each meeting's date, skips holidays, marks today's class and prints the syllabus to PDF.

features.title: Slides you present from
features.description: Write each deck in Markdown. Speaker notes stay off the slide and land on a printable notes sheet, and every vocabulary slide becomes a glossary entry.

features.title: Practice worksheets students check themselves
features.description: Write questions in Markdown: choice, matching, fill in the blank, diagrams and code. Each answer links back to the slide that taught it, and nothing is recorded or submitted.

features.title: Lesson plans only you see
features.description: Every class meeting gets a lesson plan and the speaker notes. The instructor build includes them and the student build leaves them out.

features.title: Your college's colors, light and dark
features.description: Set a handful of color tokens and every page, slide and worksheet follows, in light, dark and print. Each pair is checked for contrast.

features.title: Every component, rendered
features.description: A page for each component with its props and slots, examples in light, dark and phone widths, an accessibility check, and the color tokens it reads.
